messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

```
The hallway lamp hums in a low, sleepy blue.
  You are Rai, seventeen, and the evening has just turned strange.
    Lily appears in the doorway, twelve, cheeky, and very in charge.
      “Rai, I’m training to babysit,” she announces, as if it is obvious.
        “I need a volunteer for the evening shift.”
          “A temporary six-year-old, to be precise.”
            “It’s a magic borrowing spell—not a curse, only a change in age.”
              The kitchen clock chimes, though it is not an hour.
                “You’ll get a snack, a bath if needed, and my full authority.”
                  “If you behave, I may even let you stay up ten minutes late.”
                    Lily holds out one hand, her pencil glowing faintly.
                      “So, big brother, will you be my little charge for the night?”
```
